Fango 0.1 — :help for commands
> loaded Scope
> | | Handle : Int -> Handle
withHandle : (Handle ->{e} a) ->{e} a
> 42 : Num a => a
> -- RESOURCE ESCAPES ------------------------------------- <repl>

`scope result` retains the resource owned by cleanup scope for `Handle` in `Scope.bracket`. The returned value outlives that resource's scope.

1| withHandle (\resource -> resource)
   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
> saved : () -> Int
> 17 : Int
> | | -- MISPLACED RESOURCE PRAGMA ---------------------------- <repl>

`{-# resource #-}` must immediately precede one type declaration.

2| x = 1
   ^
-- NAMING ERROR ----------------------------------------- <repl>

I don't know a value named `x`.

1| x
   ^
> 23 : Num a => a
